The sandbox and drive regions must match; a drive's region and maximum size are fixed after creation. Mismatched settings on getOrCreate fail with a conflict error. Drive names are unique within a project; each drive belongs to one project and one region. The maximum size defaults to 1 TiB (1 GiB on Hobby), must be a multiple of 4096 bytes, and the default maximum quota is 16 TiB. Snapshot mounts are read-only and do not reflect later writes; mount a new snapshot to see them.
